slot_note: The requested seven slots are objects, quantifiers, domain, assumptions, conclusion, use, failure_boundary. The protocol’s scopes/senses and constant-dependence fields are additionally retained in assertion_scope, quantifiers, assumptions and failure_boundary.
status_boundary: Source-only cognition. No candidate selected, no source-admission verdict, no Lean comparison, no proof-graph authorship or proof validation.

seven_slots.objects: Euclidean norm, identity matrix, symmetric matrices and Loewner order.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For symmetric A,B of a common finite size.
seven_slots.domain: Real finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces and real symmetric matrices.
seven_slots.assumptions: A and B symmetric; compatible dimensions.
seven_slots.conclusion: A ⪯ B means B−A is positive semidefinite; ‖·‖ is Euclidean and I_d is the identity.
seven_slots.use: Interpret spectral bounds, quadratic inequalities and later statistics.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: This notation does not itself prove any spectral estimate or order preservation theorem.

seven_slots.objects: O(n)={O∈R^(n×n):OᵀO=I_n}, Haar probability and μ_(n,b).
seven_slots.quantifiers: Each determinant sign b∈{−1,+1}; finite positive dimension is the intended setting for the two-component assertion.
seven_slots.domain: Real orthogonal group, including both determinant components.
seven_slots.assumptions: Haar probability; ordinary positive-dimensional orthogonal group convention.
seven_slots.conclusion: Both components have mass 1/2; μ_(n,b) is Haar conditioned on det O=b.
seven_slots.use: Specify rotations and distinguish full Haar from a determinant-conditioned law.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Section 4 uses full O(d), not SO(d) or μ_(d,+1). Do not extend the two-component assertion to n=0.

seven_slots.objects: Precision matrix class A_(d,κ).
seven_slots.quantifiers: For every integer d≥1 and real κ≥1.
seven_slots.domain: Real d×d symmetric matrices.
seven_slots.assumptions: Normalized lower and upper spectral bounds 1 and κ; source says this is without loss by rescaling.
seven_slots.conclusion: A_(d,κ)={A=Aᵀ : I_d ⪯ A ⪯ κ I_d}.
seven_slots.use: Define the inputs over which sampling accuracy is uniform.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: κ is an allowed spectral/condition-number bound, not necessarily the actual extremal-eigenvalue ratio; the detailed rescaling argument is not supplied here.

seven_slots.objects: f_A(x)=xᵀAx/2, π_A and exact first-order oracle FO_A.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For each A∈A_(d,κ) and each x∈R^d.
seven_slots.domain: Real Euclidean queries; centered Gaussian output target.
seven_slots.assumptions: A is symmetric and positive definite by its spectral lower bound.
seven_slots.use: Keep the precision queried by the oracle distinct from the covariance of the sample.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The reply is A x, not A^−1 x; exact arithmetic/information is assumed, with no noisy or finite-precision oracle defined.

seven_slots.objects: Value-and-gradient, gradient-only and matrix–vector responses.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For each query x and each admissible A, in either simulation direction.
seven_slots.domain: Exact query model for quadratic potentials.
seven_slots.assumptions: Exact responses and free access to the query x; known quadratic-potential convention.
seven_slots.conclusion: FO reveals Ax; Ax determines ∇f_A and f_A=⟨x,Ax⟩/2. Thus their query complexities coincide.
seven_slots.use: Transfer the lower bound between the named exact first-order models.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: No conclusion about approximate oracle information, arithmetic operation cost, bit complexity or covariance-product access.

seven_slots.objects: Queries, stopping decisions, internal seed and output.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Every step may depend on prior responses and the seed; every admissible input and every seed realization obeys a fixed budget T.
seven_slots.domain: Borel maps; output is any R^d-valued Borel function of the same information.
seven_slots.assumptions: Seed independent of input; adaptive information dependence is permitted.
seven_slots.conclusion: A fixed query budget is a deterministic cap: at most T queries in each run.
seven_slots.use: Define the strength of algorithms covered by the lower bound.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The output need not be a query/reply-span vector; average stopping-time bounds are not this definition.

seven_slots.objects: Probability laws P,Q, measurable test sets B, densities p,q and tests h.
seven_slots.quantifiers: All measurable B; any common dominating measure λ; every measurable h valued in [0,1].
seven_slots.domain: A common measurable space.
seven_slots.assumptions: P,Q probability measures and p,q their λ-densities.
seven_slots.conclusion: TV(P,Q)=sup_B |P(B)−Q(B)|=(1/2)∫|p−q|dλ; |E_P h−E_Q h|≤TV(P,Q).
seven_slots.use: Turn per-input output accuracy into probability control of a separating event.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The expectation inequality is normalized for h∈[0,1]; unbounded quadratic statistics cannot be inserted directly as such tests.

seven_slots.objects: ρ_A^Alg, π_A, algorithm, integer budget T and Q_G(d,κ,ε).
seven_slots.quantifiers: For fixed d,κ and 0<ε<1: inf over T∈Z_≥0 such that there exists one Alg with cap T and sup over all A∈A_(d,κ) TV≤ε.
seven_slots.domain: Uniform input class, with output probability law formed from all algorithm randomness for a fixed input.
seven_slots.assumptions: Algorithm model of P2-06; accuracy and cap as just specified.
seven_slots.conclusion: Q_G is the smallest feasible capped query budget, expressed as the stated infimum.
seven_slots.use: State the minimax sampling lower bound precisely.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: This is not ∀A∃Alg, not a per-seed accuracy guarantee, and not accuracy only averaged over a prior on A.

seven_slots.objects: All paper query budgets and seed-averaged output laws.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Throughout the paper and for every run.
seven_slots.domain: The capped oracle model just defined.
seven_slots.assumptions: None beyond that model.
seven_slots.conclusion: Query budgets are deterministic caps rather than expected-query bounds; accuracy averages the seed.
seven_slots.use: Prevent changing the meaning of a lower-bound claim through a cost-model substitution.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: No expected-cost optimization problem is defined here; an expected-cost lower bound needs an additional argument and its own accuracy/cost formulation.

seven_slots.objects: The κ=2 hidden-eigenbasis lower bound attributed to reference [22].
seven_slots.quantifiers: Centered Gaussian targets with I_d⪯A⪯2I_d at ε=1/10; asymptotic lower-bound terminology.
seven_slots.domain: Prior exact-query Gaussian sampling model as described by this paper.
seven_slots.assumptions: The source attributes this earlier result to [22]; original cited paper is not among Phase 1 inputs.
seven_slots.conclusion: An Ω(log d) query lower bound was proved in [22]; §4 extends the spectral interval and studies this analysis’s limitations.
seven_slots.use: Record the section’s external provenance rather than silently count it as a locally checked proof.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: No independent verification of [22] or its precise constants/thresholds is performed; the present source is the only mathematical source input.

seven_slots.objects: Q_G(d,κ,ε) for arbitrary randomized adaptive samplers.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For every fixed δ∈(0,1), ∃d₀(δ), ∀integer d≥d₀, ∀κ∈[2,d^(1−δ)], ∀ε∈(0,1/10].
seven_slots.domain: The global exact, deterministic-cap model of §2.
seven_slots.assumptions: The stated parameter range and uniform TV accuracy.
seven_slots.conclusion: Q_G(d,κ,ε) ≥ (δ/256)√κ log d, including algorithms supplied the spectrum of the hard instance.
seven_slots.use: The section-level lower bound and its known-spectrum strength.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: No ε growth; no asserted extension beyond κ≤d^(1−δ); d₀ depends only on δ. These main-theorem restrictions are not premises of every local family fact.

seven_slots.objects: Angles θ_i, eigenvalues λ_i, diagonal Λ, rotation O and A.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For d≥2, κ≥2 and i=1,…,d; draw O independently of the seed.
seven_slots.domain: θ_i∈(0,π), real diagonal matrices and full Haar O(d).
seven_slots.conclusion: Λ=diag(λ_i); A=OΛOᵀ; f_A=xᵀAx/2 and π_A=N(0,A^−1).
seven_slots.use: A fixed-spectrum distribution of admissible inputs with unknown eigenbasis.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Local definition has no δ, ε or upper restriction κ≤d^(1−δ); neither Haar randomness nor the main-theorem asymptotic regime is needed for a pointwise admissibility statement.

seven_slots.objects: Deterministic spectrum Λ and its Gaussian normalizing constant.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For this family, the spectrum may be supplied to any algorithm.
seven_slots.domain: Known d,κ and deterministic eigenvalue list; unknown O.
seven_slots.assumptions: Fixed spectrum; normalized Gaussian integral interpretation.
seven_slots.conclusion: The normalizing constant is known; the hidden component is the eigenbasis.
seven_slots.use: Identify what the known-spectrum strengthening permits an algorithm to know.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Knowing the spectrum does not reveal O or the full matrix A; known normalizer alone is not a general Gaussian sampling construction.

seven_slots.objects: A_2 and A_κ generated from the κ=2 and κ grids.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For the same d, same O and κ≥2; for every query x.
seven_slots.domain: Matched deterministic spectra conjugated by the same real orthogonal O.
seven_slots.conclusion: A_κ=(κ−1)A_2−(κ−2)I; each one-matrix reply determines the other at the same x.
seven_slots.use: Explain oracle-information equivalence of matched hidden-eigenbasis instances.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The identity is not pointwise true for two independently chosen rotations, and does not equate the target covariances or output distributions for κ=2 and general κ.

seven_slots.objects: Frequency n=2q+1 cosine-weighted quadratic form and norm.
seven_slots.quantifiers: In the later admissible query/asymptotic regime, compare all q-query outputs with target samples.
seven_slots.domain: Family coordinates in the eigenbasis.
seven_slots.assumptions: Lemmas 4.3–4.6 and parameter discharges later in §4.3.
seven_slots.conclusion: Algorithmic normalized statistic is small while target normalized mean decays on n/√κ scale; this yields √κ log d rather than log d.
seven_slots.use: Explain why affine oracle equivalence still permits a different target-based lower-bound scale.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The informal d^(−Ω(1)) and exp(−Θ(n/√κ)) description is not an unrestricted all-q lemma; Appendix C.1–C.3 proofs are deferred, not checked in this Phase 1 slice.

seven_slots.quantifiers: All vectors g_a; integer q≥0; 1≤a≤q+1 and 0≤j≤q.
seven_slots.domain: Linear subspace of R^d in diagonal eigenbasis coordinates.
seven_slots.assumptions: A fixed diagonal Λ with compatible dimensions.
seven_slots.conclusion: K_q=span{Λ^j g_a}.
seven_slots.use: Provide an enlarged space that can contain the output of arbitrary adaptive algorithms.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The set has (q+1)^2 generators, not an a priori guaranteed independent basis.

seven_slots.objects: Output X of a q-query algorithm and Gaussian starting vectors.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Fix integer q≥0 with 2q+1<d; ∃g_1,…,g_(q+1) independent standard Gaussian vectors giving a.s. containment.
seven_slots.domain: Random input A=OΛOᵀ and algorithm model of §2.
seven_slots.assumptions: Hard-family Haar eigenbasis independent of seed; q-query output context inherited from subsection.
seven_slots.conclusion: OᵀX∈K_q almost surely, on an extension preserving the joint law of (O,X) as used in §4.3.
seven_slots.use: Handle arbitrary output functions rather than only query/reply-span outputs.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Independence stated among the Gaussian vectors does not by itself assert their independence from O or X; the extension is not a replacement of the original (O,X) law. Proof deferred to C.1.

seven_slots.objects: Polynomial representation of OᵀX.
seven_slots.quantifiers: There are polynomials p_a of degree at most q, a=1,…,q+1.
seven_slots.domain: Polynomials acting on Λ and Gaussian vectors in the extended experiment.
seven_slots.assumptions: Containment in H4-07.
seven_slots.conclusion: OᵀX=Σ_a p_a(Λ)g_a; coefficients may depend on the entire extended experiment; extra starting vector accounts for output.
seven_slots.use: Motivate a uniform-in-u bound rather than a bound for preselected polynomials.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Do not add independence/adaptivity restrictions to coefficients; existence of coefficients does not make them oracle-computable.

seven_slots.objects: D_n=diag(cos(nθ_i)), n=2q+1, K_q and τ_(d,q).
seven_slots.quantifiers: ∃absolute C>0; for integer q≥0 with 2q+1<d and independent standard Gaussians; if τ≤1/2, probability≥0.99 simultaneously for all u∈K_q.
seven_slots.domain: The local hard family; real quadratic forms and Gaussian randomness.
seven_slots.assumptions: τ=C[(q+1)√(log d/d)+(q+1)(q+1+log d)log d/d]≤1/2.
seven_slots.conclusion: |uᵀD_nu|≤2τ‖u‖² for every u∈K_q on one event.
seven_slots.use: Control coefficients depending on the full experiment and the resulting algorithm output.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: No unconditional smallness for arbitrary q; τ≤1/2 is a lemma condition to discharge, not a new premise in the public lower-bound theorem. Proof deferred to C.2.

seven_slots.objects: Polynomial Λ powers and sampled cosine polynomials.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For the same K_q, all indices a≤q+1 and j≤q.
seven_slots.domain: Cosine-grid vectors; degree-q polynomial span.
seven_slots.assumptions: κ≥2 makes λ_i a nonconstant affine function of cos θ_i.
seven_slots.conclusion: K_q equals the span of ((g_a)_i cos(jθ_i))_i; n=2q+1 lies above frequencies from products of two degree-q cosine polynomials; estimate is independent of κ.
seven_slots.use: Explain the κ-free concentration bound and its later dimensional limitation.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The affine-basis change needs nonzero slope; this argument cannot simply include κ=1. The converse polynomial span and frequency product identities require mathematical justification if formalized.

seven_slots.objects: X in ambient coordinates, O and D_n.
seven_slots.quantifiers: On the event of Lemma 4.4, for the output represented by Lemma 4.3.
seven_slots.domain: Original joint experiment, interpreted through the extension.
seven_slots.assumptions: Both lemma hypotheses, a.s. containment and O orthogonal.
seven_slots.conclusion: |XᵀOD_nOᵀX|≤2τ‖X‖².
seven_slots.use: Bridge a diagonal-coordinate uniform estimate to the observable input-based separating statistic.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The 0.99 event is a joint-experiment result; it is not asserted to occur with probability 0.99 conditional on every fixed O.

seven_slots.objects: U∼N(0,Λ^−1), r=(√κ−1)/(√κ+1), M=E‖U‖² and μ_n=E[UᵀD_nU].
seven_slots.quantifiers: For κ≥2 and integer 1≤n<d.
seven_slots.domain: Same d-point cosine eigenvalue grid; diagonal Gaussian.
seven_slots.assumptions: Local family parameters; U has covariance Λ^−1.
seven_slots.use: Compute the target mean energy and signed high-frequency bias.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Finite-d correction terms and parity matter. Replacing these by an asymptotic exponential is a separate estimate, not the exact formula. Proof deferred to C.3.

seven_slots.objects: ‖U‖² and UᵀD_nU.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Both variances, under the same parameters as H4-12.
seven_slots.domain: Target Gaussian probability space.
seven_slots.assumptions: U as in H4-12 and λ_i≥1.
seven_slots.conclusion: Both variances are at most 2M≤2d/√κ.
seven_slots.use: Supply the Chebyshev bound for the separating test.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The two quadratic forms are not claimed independent; their covariance need not vanish.

seven_slots.objects: Normalized bias β=|μ_n|/M.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For H4-12 parameters, additionally if d−n≥√κ.
seven_slots.domain: Positive mean M and frequency 1≤n<d.
seven_slots.assumptions: The stated separation from the grid-size boundary.
seven_slots.use: Compare target bias with the κ-independent algorithmic tolerance.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Keep the extra condition attached to this displayed two-sided estimate; no corresponding assertion for n≥d is supplied.

seven_slots.objects: Conditional exact sample Y|O∼π_A and U=OᵀY.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For each orthogonal O in the family.
seven_slots.domain: R^d under conditional Gaussian laws.
seven_slots.assumptions: Target covariance A^−1 and A=OΛOᵀ.
seven_slots.conclusion: U has law N(0,Λ^−1), ‖Y‖²=‖U‖² and YᵀOD_nOᵀY=UᵀD_nU.
seven_slots.use: Use eigenbasis target moments for every hard-family input.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: This is a target-law transport identity, not an assertion about the algorithm output law.

seven_slots.objects: A=OΛOᵀ built from the cosine spectrum.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For every O∈O(d).
seven_slots.domain: Local family d≥2 and κ≥2 inherited from §4.1.
seven_slots.assumptions: No random draw, no determinant-sign restriction, no algorithm or q required.
seven_slots.conclusion: I_d ⪯ A ⪯ κ I_d.
seven_slots.use: Make the random hard family admissible for the global uniform guarantee.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The numbered lemma states this spectral conclusion. Additional calculus and normalization facts occur in C.4 proof prose; they are not automatically additional conjuncts of the printed lemma.

seven_slots.objects: θ_i, cos θ_i, λ_i, Λ and A.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For every i=1,…,d and every O∈O(d).
seven_slots.domain: Local d≥2, κ≥2 cosine-grid family.
seven_slots.assumptions: 0<θ_i<π and positive affine slope (κ−1)/2.
seven_slots.conclusion: −1<cos θ_i<1; hence 1<λ_i<κ; orthogonal conjugation gives the non-strict Loewner bounds.
seven_slots.use: Establish Lemma 4.6 and positive definiteness.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The proof compresses diagonal quadratic-form bounds and orthogonal conjugation. Those are standard mathematical bridges requiring proof in a formalization; the displayed source chain is not already a formal proof.

seven_slots.objects: V_A(x)=xᵀAx/2, denoted f_A in §2/§4.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For all x∈R^d and every family O.
seven_slots.domain: Smooth real functions on R^d.
seven_slots.assumptions: Fixed real symmetric A=OΛOᵀ.
seven_slots.conclusion: V_A is C∞ and ∇²V_A(x)=A.
seven_slots.use: Embed the Gaussian hard instance into smooth strongly log-concave sampling.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Symmetry matters for the gradient/Hessian identification; it is derived from the construction, not a new unmotivated public premise. No higher-derivative bound for other nonquadratic potentials is asserted.

seven_slots.objects: Quadratic V_A and constants 1,κ.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Globally on R^d for each family A.
seven_slots.domain: Euclidean strong convexity and gradient smoothness.
seven_slots.assumptions: Hessian A and I_d⪯A⪯κI_d.
seven_slots.conclusion: V_A is 1-strongly convex and κ-smooth.
seven_slots.use: Check the hard instance lies in the conventional Hessian-bounded potential class.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: These are valid parameter bounds, not claims that the optimal strong-convexity or smoothness constants equal 1 or κ. Precise standard-definition equivalences are not expanded in C.4.

seven_slots.objects: V_A, the origin and arbitrary nonzero x.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For all x≠0, with V_A(0)=0.
seven_slots.domain: R^d.
seven_slots.assumptions: Spectral lower bound A⪰I_d.
seven_slots.conclusion: V_A(x)≥‖x‖²/2>0 for x≠0; 0 is the unique minimizer.
seven_slots.use: Show this family is hard even when the minimizer is known.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The strict inequality is for x≠0; positivity at 0 is not asserted. This argument supplies a location fact without restricting O.

seven_slots.objects: Unnormalized density exp(−V_A), target and normalizing constant Z_A.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For each family A (hence for every O) at fixed d and κ.
seven_slots.domain: Lebesgue Gaussian integral over R^d; positive determinants.
seven_slots.assumptions: A symmetric positive definite; Gaussian integration and orthogonal-conjugacy determinant identity.
seven_slots.conclusion: Associated target is N(0,A^−1); Z_A=(2π)^(d/2)(det A)^(−1/2)=(2π)^(d/2)(det Λ)^(−1/2).
seven_slots.use: Identify normalization and show eigenbasis independence.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Z_A is the integral normalizer, not its reciprocal density prefactor. The source does not derive the multivariate Gaussian integral here; formal acceptance requires that result rather than assuming the formula.

seven_slots.objects: det(OΛOᵀ) and det O.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For all O∈O(d), including det O=−1.
seven_slots.domain: Finite real square matrices.
seven_slots.assumptions: OᵀO=I; determinant multiplicativity and transpose invariance.
seven_slots.conclusion: det A=(det O)^2 det Λ=det Λ, and det Λ>0 by λ_i>1.
seven_slots.use: Explain why the normalizer is constant on the full orthogonal orbit.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: This expanded calculation is reviewer inference from standard identities, not an additional displayed C.4 theorem. No det O=+1 premise is licensed or needed.

seven_slots.objects: Z_A and fixed Λ.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For all O, at fixed d,κ; whenever the spectrum is public.
seven_slots.domain: The family’s exact-information oracle setting.
seven_slots.assumptions: The displayed formula C4-05 and fixed Λ.
seven_slots.conclusion: Z_A does not depend on O and is known from the public spectrum.
seven_slots.use: Support lower-bound robustness to revealing the spectrum/normalizer.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Not a claim that all admissible A share one normalizer; κ or d changes can change Z. No efficient finite-bit evaluation complexity is defined.

seven_slots.objects: A putative sampler, integer query cap q and per-input output law.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Fix δ∈(0,1), κ∈[2,d^(1−δ)], ε∈(0,1/10]; suppose one algorithm has q≤(δ/256)√κ log d and TV≤ε for every admissible A.
seven_slots.domain: Large d to be chosen depending only on δ; §2 model.
seven_slots.assumptions: The stated hypothetical guarantee; hard family admissible by Lemma 4.6.
seven_slots.conclusion: The hypothetical algorithm must work on every hard-family A.
seven_slots.use: Start a contradiction through random-input averaging.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: This is not a weaker prior-average accuracy assumption; q is a deterministic cap, and the family prior is introduced by the proof.

seven_slots.objects: n=2q+1, τ=τ_(d,q), Chebyshev polynomial T_n, S_A and E_A.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For each family A and every x∈R^d.
seven_slots.domain: Borel quadratic statistic; T_n first-kind degree n polynomial.
seven_slots.use: Use one test event per input in the TV comparison.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Strict event uses >0; 0 does not pass. Polynomial dependence on A makes E_A input-defined without choosing an eigenbasis representative. Measurability follows from standard continuity, not an extra accuracy premise.

seven_slots.objects: Weights w_i(x)=|⟨x,Oe_i⟩|²/‖x‖² and cosine coefficient.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For x≠0 and the same family decomposition A=OΛOᵀ.
seven_slots.domain: Nonnegative weights summing to one.
seven_slots.assumptions: Orthogonal eigenbasis; T_n(cos θ_i)=cos(nθ_i).
seven_slots.conclusion: E_A is equivalent to (−1)^n Σ_i w_i(x)cos(nθ_i)>2τ; signed coefficient has target sign.
seven_slots.use: Relate the polynomial-in-A event to diagonal statistics in Lemmas 4.4–4.5.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Do not divide by ‖x‖² at x=0; that point is handled directly by S_A(0)=0. Matrix polynomial conjugation is a standard bridge, not supplied as a separate lemma.

seven_slots.objects: q+1, n, τ and d.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For sufficiently large d depending only on fixed δ, uniformly for κ and q in T4-01.
seven_slots.domain: Integer q≥0; log d in the large-d regime.
seven_slots.use: Discharge conditional hypotheses of Lemmas 4.3–4.4 internally.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Limits mean fixed δ>0 and uniform κ in the range, not uniform as δ→0; hidden absolute constants and eventual dimension thresholds require bookkeeping.

seven_slots.objects: Original random (O,X) experiment and E_A.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Over random O and all algorithm randomness, via a law-preserving extension.
seven_slots.domain: Hard-family prior and output kernels.
seven_slots.assumptions: H4-07, H4-09 and T4-04; functional-calculus identity.
seven_slots.conclusion: With probability≥0.99 the unsigned quadratic form is ≤2τ‖X‖², so S_A(X)≤0 and E_A[ρ_A^Alg(E_A)]≤0.01.
seven_slots.use: One side of the averaged separating test.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: The bound is prior averaged; do not promote it to a pointwise bound on ρ_A^Alg(E_A) for every A. Coupling/extension dependence must preserve (O,X).

seven_slots.quantifiers: For sufficiently large d depending only on δ and all stated κ,q.
seven_slots.domain: The same family and n=2q+1.
seven_slots.assumptions: n=o(d), √κ=o(d) imply d−n≥√κ; Lemma 4.5; 3n/√κ≤3+(3δ/128)log d.
seven_slots.use: Keep target mean signal above algorithmic tolerance and variance scale.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: These are derived eventual bounds, not independent public theorem assumptions. The exact r and M formulas remain distinct from their relaxed estimates.

seven_slots.objects: τ/β, Mβ² and final dimension threshold.
seven_slots.quantifiers: For each fixed δ, choose d₀ large enough for every allowed κ,q.
seven_slots.domain: Large integers d; constants C′ absolute and b fixed.
seven_slots.conclusion: τ/β≤(C′/b)d^(−δ/4)(log d)^3→0; Mβ²≥(b²/2)√d→∞. Choose d₀ so τ≤β/4 and Mβ²≥320, alongside prior conditions.
seven_slots.use: Discharge every conditional estimate used in the test.
seven_slots.failure_boundary: Uniformity in κ,q must be preserved; selecting d₀ after seeing an individual input, algorithm seed or ε would change the theorem.

seven_slots.objects: Fixed A, target Y and Z=S_A(Y).
seven_slots.quantifiers: For every A in the hard family.
